the DEAH box protein Prp43p facilitates the discard of sub-optimal splicing intermediates and the disassembly of the spliceosome after exon ligation.

the DEAH box protein Prp43p is required to discard mutated lariat intermediatives, which are translated by the ribosome, and to promote the repressing splices at cryptic splice sites.
